sentences.zh: 我确实有了新的职业目标。

sentences.en: Well, you know what?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道吗？

sentences.en: A late in life new career goal.
sentences.zh: 一个人生后半段的新职业目标。

sentences.en: We all have goals for our seasons of life.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人在人生的不同阶段都有不同的目标。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And your goal for this season is a Tony.
sentences.zh: 而你这个阶段的目标就是托尼奖。

sentences.en: Well, I want to end with this wonderful letter.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我想用这封精彩的信来作为结尾。

sentences.en: It's going to be our final word here on the All About Pam Beasley episode.
sentences.zh: 这将是我们“关于帕姆·比斯利”这一集的最后感言。

sentences.en: It's from Allison C.
sentences.zh: 它来自佛罗里达州的艾莉森·C。

sentences.en: in Florida.
sentences.zh: 来自佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: And Allison wrote in and said this.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森写道：

sentences.en: When I first watched The Office in middle school, Pam was one of the first characters I ever fully saw myself in.
sentences.zh: 我初中第一次看《办公室》时，帕姆是我第一个能完全产生共鸣的角色。

sentences.en: My dad describes me as having quiet strength.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸形容我有一种安静的力量。

sentences.en: And I don't think there's a better phrase to describe Pam Beasley.
sentences.zh: 我觉得没有比这更适合形容帕姆·比斯利的词了。

sentences.en: Watching her blossom as the show went on gave me hope for myself.
sentences.zh: 看着她随着剧集的发展不断蜕变，也让我对自己充满了希望。

sentences.en: In the final episode, Pam quoted,
sentences.zh: 在最后一集中，帕姆引用了一句话：

sentences.en: It would just make my heart sore if someone out there saw this and said to herself,
sentences.zh: 如果有人看到这里并对自己说，那我的心会感到一阵酸楚，

sentences.en: Be strong.
sentences.zh: 要坚强。

sentences.en: Trust yourself.
sentences.zh: 要相信自己。

sentences.en: Love yourself.
sentences.zh: 要爱自己。

sentences.en: Conquer your fears.
sentences.zh: 要战胜恐惧。

sentences.en: Just go after what you want.
sentences.zh: 去追求你想要的。

sentences.en: And act faSt.
sentences.zh: 并且要快。

sentences.en: Because life just isn't that long.
sentences.zh: 因为人生苦短。

sentences.en: Pam would be proud to know that a little girl watching
sentences.zh: 如果帕姆知道有个小女孩在看剧时

sentences.en: latched on to those words.
sentences.zh: 记住了这些话，她一定会感到骄傲的。

sentences.en: I even printed it out and tacked it on my bedroom wall where it remained all throughout my high school years.
sentences.zh: 我甚至把它打印出来贴在卧室墙上，整个高中时期它一直都在那里。

sentences.en: That little girl now has her first office job post-college and loves the office more than ever.
sentences.zh: 那个小女孩现在大学毕业有了第一份办公室工作，而且比以往任何时候都更爱《办公室》这部剧。

sentences.en: And that little girl fully believes that Pam was the main subject of the documentary.
sentences.zh: 那个小女孩坚信帕姆才是这部纪录片的主角。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you, Allison.
sentences.zh: 噢，谢谢你，艾莉森。

sentences.en: She says,
sentences.zh: 她说，

sentences.en: That's my personal soapbox.
sentences.zh: 这是我的个人感言。

sentences.en: From the quiet, creative girls all around the world,
sentences.zh: 代表全世界所有安静、有创造力的女孩，

sentences.en: thank you, Jenna, for showing us that there's a lot of beauty in ordinary things.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，珍娜，让我们看到平凡事物中也蕴含着许多美好。

sentences.en: That is kind of the point after all.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，这正是这部剧的意义所在。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: That really moved me.
sentences.zh: 这真的触动了我。

sentences.en: You know, that quote, I said it.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，那句台词是我说的。

sentences.en: I didn't write it.
sentences.zh: 但我并没有写它。

sentences.en: That is the heart of Greg Daniels.
sentences.zh: 那正是格雷格·丹尼尔斯的核心所在。

sentences.en: That's the message he wanted people to take from this character and this beautiful arc that he crafted along with all the other writers for me to play.
sentences.zh: 那是他希望人们从这个角色，以及他和所有其他编剧为我精心打造的这段美妙弧光中领悟到的信息。

sentences.en: And, I mean, letters like that are exactly why I don't need to be remembered for doing anything else.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，像那样的信件正是为什么我不需要因为做其他任何事而被人们记住的原因。

sentences.en: It's just beautiful.
sentences.zh: 这真是太美好了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, we just love you guys so much.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们真的非常爱你们。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for listening to Office Ladies and Office Ladies 6.0 and your support over the years and just these great questions.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们收听《办公室女士》和《办公室女士 6.0》，感谢你们多年来的支持，以及这些很棒的问题。

sentences.en: We just love doing this.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很喜欢做这件事。

sentences.en: And thank you.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And thank you, Sam, Cassie, and Angela, for my birthday celebration.
sentences.zh: 还要谢谢萨姆、卡西和安吉拉为我举办的生日庆祝活动。

sentences.en: You know, last year I turned 50, and I didn't get a big birthday because I was actually in chemotherapy for my 50th birthday.
sentences.zh: 你们知道，去年我五十岁了，但我没能过一个盛大的生日，因为我五十岁生日那天其实正在接受化疗。

sentences.en: So this year is an extra special milestone, and you've kicked it off in the best way.
sentences.zh: 所以今年是一个格外特别的里程碑，而你们以最好的方式为它拉开了序幕。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Well, let's go eat some cake.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们去吃蛋糕吧。

sentences.en: Let's do it.
sentences.zh: 走吧。

sentences.en: You guys have a great week.
sentences.zh: 祝大家度过愉快的一周。
